name: siheom-ts
description: siheom monorepo — data-first frontend test interpreter
author: Taehee Kim <rabolution@gmail.com> (https://x.com/stelo_kim)

scripts.ci: yarn check-format && yarn sync:check && yarn build && yarn npm audit --all --recursive --no-deprecations && yarn lint && yarn check-exports && yarn typecheck && yarn test
scripts.build: yarn workspace @siheom/core build && yarn workspace @siheom/react build && yarn workspace @siheom/vue build && yarn workspace @siheom/svelte build && yarn workspace @siheom/solid build && yarn workspace @siheom/angular build && yarn workspace @siheom/qwik build && yarn workspace @siheom/react-native build && yarn workspace @siheom/ime build && yarn workspace @siheom/ime-cdp build && yarn workspace @siheom/vitest-browser-react build && yarn workspace @siheom/virtual-screen-reader build
scripts.check-exports: yarn workspace @siheom/core check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/react check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/vue check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/svelte check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/solid check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/angular check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/qwik check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/react-native check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/ime check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/ime-cdp check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/vitest-browser-react check-exports && yarn workspace @siheom/virtual-screen-reader check-exports
scripts.test: yarn test:validate-configs && yarn test:validate-artifacts && yarn workspace @siheom/core test && yarn workspace @siheom/react test && yarn workspace @siheom/vue test && yarn workspace @siheom/svelte test && yarn workspace @siheom/solid test && yarn workspace @siheom/angular test && yarn workspace @siheom/qwik test && yarn workspace @siheom/ime test && yarn workspace @siheom/ime-cdp test && yarn workspace @siheom/react-example test && yarn workspace @siheom/react-native test && yarn workspace @siheom/react-native-examples test && yarn workspace @siheom/vitest-browser-react test && yarn workspace @siheom/virtual-screen-reader test
scripts.local-check: yarn format && yarn lint:fix && yarn build && yarn check-exports && yarn typecheck && yarn workspace @siheom/react-example test && yarn workspace @siheom/ime test && yarn workspace @siheom/ime-cdp test && yarn workspace @siheom/virtual-screen-reader test
scripts.dup:jscpd: jscpd packages/core/src packages/react/src packages/ime/src packages/ime-cdp/src apps/react-example/test
scripts.dup:nose: nose query -r packages/core/src -r packages/react/src -r packages/ime/src -r packages/ime-cdp/src -r apps/react-example/test top=20 --exclude '**/stories/headless/**' --exclude '**/components/ariakit/**' --exclude '**/components/ark-ui/**' --exclude '**/components/radix/**' --exclude '**/components/react-aria/**' --exclude '**/components/ui/**'
